svg.title: D-FINE-S + AQS-L2 - source-checked flow
svg.desc: Reference-style native-vector inference overview of the actual three-layer D-FINE-S AQS-L2 model. P5 AIFI and original FPN/PAN produce three-scale memory. Original score-based Top300 initializes queries. L2 original classifier/LQE supplies AQS gate logits, and L2 FDR is computed before AQS. Refined query content reaches L3; all 300 ordinary queries remain. Classroom tiles are schematic.
